title: Perturbation Method in Musielak-Orlicz Sequence Spaces
summary: We generalize an abstract variational principle in Banach spaces, introduced by Topalova \& Zlateva, by showing that the set $\mathbb{P}_0$ of perturbations for which a perturbed lower semi-continuous function $f$ is WPMC (Well Posed Modulus Compact) not only contains a dense $G_δ$ subset, but is also a complement to a $σ$-porous subset in a specifically defined positive cone.
